basics.name: Anthony Aguilar Sanchez
basics.label: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with a full-stack and backend-systems background, transitioning into data engineering. Experience building event-driven, pub/sub microservices, CRM/data integration pipelines, and large-scale operational data processing (fraud-tracking, offline-first sync). Practiced with AWS (EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, load balancing/autoscaling) through a dedicated cloud computing course and personal project deployments, plus PySpark and SQL-based data processing from a big data course. Comfortable with Python at a strong working level and applies core machine learning concepts (train/test methodology, classification vs. regression, pretrained model deployment) in personal projects using PyTorch.

work.name: APU Tech
work.summary: Developed mobile and web applications for an agriculture-sector company, including an offline-first field data pipeline used to record phytosanitary (crop health) data in areas without internet access.
highlights: Built an offline-first data collection pipeline for field agronomists, syncing phytosanitary data from rural areas with no internet access once connectivity was restored
Integrated the field data-collection pipeline with the company CRM system, reducing manual data entry by 60%
Processed and visualized collected field data into an executive dashboard, including per-parcel breakdowns and a field heatmap revealing cultivar health
Maintained a full-stack data platform serving 500+ daily active users with 99.9% uptime

work.name: Balto SAS
work.summary: Architected an event-driven referrals system and internal data tools using a microservices/pub-sub backend.
highlights: Designed and built a referrals system backed by microservices communicating through a pub/sub event architecture
Designed and developed 10+ internal data/reporting tools that automated 80% of manual operational tasks, tracking thousands of purchases and integrating with 3rd-party systems
Reduced system response time by 40% through database optimization and caching strategies

work.name: Movistar
work.summary: Maintained an enterprise application used to track salesmen activity and detect fraud, involving large-scale operational data processing.
highlights: Managed enterprise sales-tracking and fraud-detection data application serving 1,000+ daily users with 99.5% uptime
Refactored 10,000+ lines of legacy data-processing code, reducing complexity by 14% and improving maintainability

Cloud Computing course: designed and deployed a multi-tenant restaurant management platform on AWS (EC2 with load balancing and autoscaling, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Lambda, WebSockets for real-time notifications), including geospatial delivery tracking and an ETL analytics pipeline processing 50M+ simulated records
Big Data course: used PySpark for data analysis and processing exercises
Participated in multiple hackathons and coding competitions

awards.title: Third Place Winner, Hackathon Movistar
awards.summary: Developed innovative web scraper solution that extracted and processed data 3x faster than existing methods.

projects.name: Multi-Tenant Restaurant Platform on AWS
projects.description: University cloud computing project: a multi-tenant restaurant management platform (simulating multiple locations, staff/client/delivery apps) deployed on AWS.
highlights: Designed a multi-tenant database architecture on DynamoDB supporting independent restaurant locations
Deployed the application on EC2 behind a load balancer with autoscaling, served static/unstructured assets from S3
Built API Gateway endpoints and Lambda functions, using WebSockets for real-time order and delivery notifications across staff, client, and delivery-driver apps
Implemented geospatial delivery tracking and an ETL analytics pipeline generating business reports over 50M+ simulated records

projects.name: RAG Discord Bot with Database Query Access
projects.description: Big Data course project: a retrieval-augmented generation system integrated with a Discord bot that answers questions by querying a business database under scoped, safe permissions.
highlights: Built a RAG pipeline connecting an LLM to a live database to answer natural-language queries
Scoped database permissions to prevent unintended or harmful actions on business data
Used PySpark for data analysis as part of the course curriculum

projects.name: Linguaphile.app - Vocabulary Acquisition via YouTube
projects.description: Personal project (in progress) that collects and analyzes YouTube video transcriptions across languages to fit a word-frequency distribution model, then samples the minimal vocabulary needed to start acquiring a language through videos of personal interest.
highlights: Collected and processed thousands of YouTube video transcriptions across multiple languages
Fit a statistical distribution model over word frequency per language
Implemented sampling from the fitted distribution to generate minimal-vocabulary learning sets
Deployed a working prototype at linguaphile.app

projects.name: Speech2Text Batch Translator
projects.description: Queue-based batch audio translation service allowing multiple users to upload and process files concurrently under limited compute resources, using OpenAI's pretrained Whisper models.
highlights: Built the backend in Python, with a queue-based processing system to fairly schedule multi-user batch jobs on constrained hardware
Deployed pretrained Whisper models via PyTorch for speech-to-text transcription and translation inference
Containerized the full pipeline with Docker for reproducible deployment

projects.name: R-tree Spatial Indexing System
projects.description: Advanced Data Structures course project: implemented R-tree data structure for efficient multidimensional spatial indexing.
highlights: Reduced spatial query time by 70% compared to linear search
Handled 1M+ data points with sub-millisecond query performance
